beef-and-vegetables-including-carrots-br.title: Beef and vegetables (carrots, broccoli, dark-green leafy)

content.title: About
content.content: The dish consists of lean beef cubes combined with a mix of vegetables: carrots, broccoli and dark‑green leafy greens (spinach, kale, Swiss chard). It is prepared without potatoes or sauce, making it low‑calorie and nutrient‑dense.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Beef is a complete source of protein, providing all essential amino acids.
Broccoli is rich in vitamin C and sulforaphane, compounds with strong antioxidant properties.
Carrots contain beta‑carotene, which the body converts to vitamin A for eye health.
Dark‑green leafy greens supply high levels of vitamins K, A and folate.
Omitting potatoes and sauce reduces simple carbohydrates and added fats.

items.title: Supports muscle mass
items.content: Beef protein aids muscle growth and repair, especially important for active individuals.

items.title: Boosts immunity
items.content: Vitamin C from broccoli and beta‑carotene from carrots enhance the body’s defense mechanisms.

items.title: Bone health
items.content: Vitamin K and calcium from leafy greens promote bone mineralization and help prevent osteoporosis.

items.title: Antioxidant protection
items.content: Sulforaphane and carotenoids neutralize free radicals, lowering the risk of chronic diseases.

items.title: Digestive support
items.content: Fiber from the vegetables improves gut motility and supports a healthy microbiome.

items.title: Food allergies
items.content: Some individuals may be allergic to beef or certain leafy greens.

items.title: Saturated fat content
items.content: Choosing lean cuts of beef is essential to keep saturated fat intake moderate.

items.title: Oxalates in leafy greens
items.content: High oxalate levels can contribute to kidney stone formation in susceptible people.

items.title: Fiber tolerance
items.content: Large amounts of raw vegetables may cause gastrointestinal discomfort for sensitive individuals.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Sauté the beef and vegetables quickly in a small amount of olive oil over medium‑high heat. Season with a pinch of salt and herbs such as rosemary or thyme. Serve hot, optionally with a whole‑grain side or enjoy on its own.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the cooked dish in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days. For longer storage, freeze in a freezer‑safe bag for up to 2 months after cooling.
